articles.title: Gamers Nexus highlights ASUS vulnerabilities as 2025 exploits hit routers and bloatware
articles.description: Gamers Nexus reports that ASUS faces multiple security issues in 2025, with active exploits targeting its routers and flaws affecting utilities like DriverHub, MyASUS, and Armory Crate. The coverage warns that persistent backdoors and low-level code vulnerabilities make firmware updates and the removal of unnecessary ASUS software essential for user safety.
